summary: Engadget's Jeff Dunn rounds up Black Friday 2023 deals on headphones and earbuds, mostly products that top Engadget's buying guides for wireless headphones, wireless earbuds, budget earbuds and gaming headsets. Each entry gives the sale price, how it compares with the all-time low or usual street price, Engadget's review score and the product's main strengths and weaknesses. Models range from premium Sony, Apple and Bose sets to budget picks like EarFun and JLab, plus wired gaming and bone-conduction options.
one_line: Engadget's 2023 Black Friday roundup of discounted headphones and earbuds from Sony, Apple, Bose, Beats, Anker and others, with prices and review scores.
key_facts: The Sony WH-1000XM5 is $328 (down $72 from $400) at Amazon, B&H and others, tying its lowest price; it is Engadget's top pick for best wireless headphones, scored 95, with about 30 hours of battery.
The Sony WF-1000XM5 earbuds are $248, $52 below list and matching the lowest price; they top Engadget's wireless earbuds list, scored 87, and last about seven to eight hours.
The older Sony WH-1000XM4 is $248, $100 off list, and scored 94 in 2020; unlike the XM5 it folds up, but its mics are weaker.
Apple AirPods Pro (USB-C case) are $190 at Amazon, Walmart, Target and Best Buy, $60 less than Apple's price and tying an all-time low; they scored 88 and have about six hours of battery.
Apple AirPods Max are $450 at Amazon and Best Buy versus Apple's $550; Engadget scored them 84 in late 2020 and calls them overpriced for most people.
Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones are $379 ($50 off), scored 86 and were released a month earlier; Engadget still recommends the Sony XM5 for most people.
Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds are $249, an all-time low, scored 88 and are Engadget's 'best for noise cancellation' earbuds pick, with about six hours of battery.
Beats Studio Pro is $170, about $130 below its average street price and $10 under its previous low; it scored 81 in July.
The Anker Soundcore Space A40 is $54 (normally $79), tying its lowest price, and tops Engadget's budget wireless earbuds guide with up to 10 hours of battery.
The EarFun Free 2S is $24.59 at Amazon with the Prime-only code FREE2SPD1, an all-time low, and is the 'best under $50' budget earbuds pick.
The Beyerdynamic DT 900 Pro X wired open-back headphones are $249 and are Engadget's top pick for gaming headphones; the Astro A40 TR with MixAmp M80 is $100.
The Shokz OpenRun Pro bone conduction headphones are $125 (down $55 from $180), $25 above their all-time low, with up to 10 hours per charge.
The Google Pixel Buds Pro hit a new low of $115 at Wellbots and are Engadget's best earbuds pick for Android users; they scored 87 last year.
